text: S565 diagnosed the S564 waistband mismatch: the selected CLO left-side CUT vertices carried +20 mm steps although source mapping keeps them fixed, so both sides translated and the width stayed XS. In a disposable CLO project, zeroing only the left CUT increments while retaining +20 mm on the right produced CUT matches for XS/S/M/L/XL within 0.001 cm. Larger-size SEW residuals remain 2.0/2.5/2.915463/2.915463 cm; the nearest L/XL candidates are not semantically identified. CLO re-import rendered one waistband outline, not a five-size overlay, and reported absent seam allowances/Custom mode. This is partial diagnostic evidence only. Keep all V03 profile, recipe-coverage, semantic, malformed-input and round-trip gates held. See E-G04-S565-EXIT.
